items.title: 4 Burning Questions for Knicks Expert on Raptors' Trey Jemison III
items.author: Yahoo Sports
items.body_excerpt: 4 Burning Questions for Knicks Expert on Raptors' Trey Jemison III Yahoo Sports

items.title: Raps sign Trey Jemison III to a two-way deal. He's played 76 NBA games with five teams over three years. He'll turn 27 in November, so definitely someone they're hoping can contribute in a pinch. 6-10, 270, went undrafted in 2023.
